content: “D man aya i d asen ɣa tegged, ḥima ad ten tessqeddsed, maḥend ad ayi iřin d ikehhanen. Ksi ijj n ufunas - ameẓyan n ufunas - d tnayen n wacraren icnan qaɛ,
u ɛawed aɣrum břa antun d řemsemnat břa antun ixeǧḍen s zzect d teřfaf břa antun ttwadehnent s zzect, tinni i ɣa tegged marra s waren azdad n yirden.
Ad tent tegged deg ict n tsuǧet uca ad tent tawyed di tsuǧet jmiɛ ak-d ufunas ameẓyan d tnayen n icarriyyen.
Ad dd-tessqarrbed Harun d warraw nnes ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar uca ad ten tessirded s waman.
Ad teksid arruḍ, ad tyarḍed Harun tcamir d useřḥam i upalṭu d upalṭu simant nnes d tejmect uca ad as tbeysed s tḥezzamt izewwqen n upalṭu.
Ad tessarsed areẓẓet x uzeǧif nnes u x areẓẓet ad tegged ttaj iqeddsen n weɛzař.
Ad teksid zzect i wedhan uca ad tt tzeǧɛed x uzeǧif nnes uca ad t tdehned.
Xenni ad tawyed iḥenjiren nnes, ad asen tyarḍed tcamirat.
Ad asen tbeysed s tḥezzamt, i Harun d warraw nnes, uca ad asen tarekkbed ticuccay. Ad ɣarsen tiři tukehhant ɛlaḥsab ict n tewṣeyyet i řebda. Ad tařeqqmed Harun d warraw nnes.
Xenni ad tawyed afunas ameẓyan zzat i Uqiḍun n Umsagar u Harun d warraw nnes ad ssarsen ifassen nsen x uzeǧif n ufunas ameẓyan.
Ad tɣarṣed i ufunas ameẓyan zzat i wudem n SIDI, ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar.
Xenni ad teksid idammen n ufunas ameẓyan uca ad ten tegged s uḍaḍ nnec x waccawen n uɛalṭar uca ad tzeǧɛed marra idammen iqqimen ɣar iḍaren n uɛalṭar.
Ad teksid ɛawed marra tadunt nni idřin adan d min yuyřen ɣar tsa, d tnayen n tiẓẓař ak-d tadunt i xasent iǧan uca ad tessbexxared aya x uɛalṭar.
Maca aysum n ufunas ameẓyan d yiřem nnes d umessař nnes ad ten tesscemḍed s tmessi barra i řmargeḥ n řɛeskar, aqa d taɣarṣt n ddenb.
Xenni ad teksid ijj n ucarri uca Harun d warraw nnes ad ssarsen ifassen nsen x uzeǧif n icarri.
Ad tɣarṣed i icarri uca ad teksid idammen nnes, ad ten tzeǧɛed x uɛalṭar zi marra iɣezdisen nnes.
Ad tebḍid icarri d iceǧiqen, ad tessirded adan nnes d icekrad nnes uca ad ten tegged x iceǧiqen nnes u x uzeǧif nnes.
Ad tessiɣed i icarri am ikmeř x uɛalṭar, aqa d taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ i SIDI, ict n řefwaḥet ittfuḥen, aqa d ict n tewhibt n tmessi i SIDI.
Xenni ad teksid icarri nneɣni uca Harun d warraw nnes ad ssarsen ifassen nsen x uzeǧif n icarri.

Ad tɣarṣed i icarri uca ad teksid zeg idammen nnes uca ad tegged man aya x iɣes n umezzuɣ afusi n Harun u x iɣes n umezzuɣ afusi n warraw nnes u ɛawed x uḍaḍ n yimez n ufus nsen afusi u x uḍaḍ n yimez n uḍar nsen afusi uca ad tzeǧɛed iḍammen iqqimen x uɛalṭar zi kuř jjihet.

Xenni ad teksid zeg idammen nni iǧan x uɛalṭar u zi zzect i wedhan uca ad zzaysen trucced Harun d warruḍ nnes uca ad trucced ɛawed arraw nnes d arruḍ n warraw nnes akides, ḥima ad yiři ittwaqeddes, netta d arruḍ nnes, uřa d tarwa nnes d arruḍ n tarwa nnes akides.
Ad teksid tadunt n icarri řa d tadunt ɣar unewwar řa tadunt nni idřin adan, uřa min yuyřen ɣar tsa d tnayen n tiẓẓař s tadunt i xasent iǧan d acekrud afusi, minzi wa d icarri i udeccen n ikehhanen.
Ksi ɛawed ict n tecnift n weɣrum d ict n temsemment n weɣrum ittwasswejden s zzect d ict n teřfeft zi tsuǧet n weɣrum břa antun i iǧan zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Sars man aya marra x ifassen n Harun u x ifassen n warraw nnes uca ad ten tessenhezzed zi ssa ɣar da am ict n tewhibt n wenhezzi zzat i wudem n SIDI.
Awarni as ad tt teksid zeg ifassen nsen uca ad tt tessbexxared x uɛalṭar, x tɣarṣt n wecmaḍ, ad tiři d ict n řefwaḥet ittfuḥen zzat i wudem n SIDI. Aqa-tt d ict n tewhibt n tmessi i SIDI.
Ad teksid idmaren n icarri i udeccen n Harun uca ad ten tᵉssenhezzed zi ssa ɣar da am ict n tewhibt n wenhezzi zzat i wudem n SIDI. Tanita ad tiři d tasɣart nnec.

Ad tessqeddsed idmaren n tewhibt n wenhezzi i ittwanhezzen zi ssa ɣar da, uřa d ucekrud i ittwanhezzen zi ssa ɣar da d wenni ittwassgeɛɛden. Aqa-ten zeg icarri n udeccen, am zeg wenni i yeǧan i Harun am zeg wenni i yeǧan i warraw nnes.

Aya ad yiři i Harun d warraw nnes d ict n tewṣeyyet i řebda zi jjihet n ayt n Israil, minzi d tawhibt n usgeɛɛed i teǧa. Ad tiři d ict n tewhibt i ɣa ssgeɛɛden ayt n Israil zi tɣarṣa nsen n řehna. Aqa d tawhibt nsen n usgeɛɛed i SIDI.
Arruḍ iqeddsen n Harun ad yiři i warraw nnes awarni as, maḥend ad ten dehnen u ad ten ařeqmen dayes.
Man wen zeg iḥenjiren nnes i ɣa yiřin d akehhan deg wemcan nnes uca ad yadef ɣar Uqiḍun n Umsagar, maḥend ad isexxar di Zzawect Iqeddsen, ad t yarḍ sebɛa n wussan.
Ad teksid icarri i udeccen uca ad tᵉssengwed aysum nnes deg ijj n wemcan iqeddsen.
Harun d warraw nnes ad ccen aysum n icarri d weɣrum i iǧan di tsuǧet ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar.
Ad ccen zi min zi ittwagg wesřaḥ, ḥima ad ten řeqqmen u ad ten ssqeddsen. Maca ijj n ubarrani war zzayes ittett, minzi aqa d ict n řḥajjet d tamqeddest.
Mařa iceṭṭ ca zeg weysum n tɣarṣa i udeccen niɣ zeg weɣrum ař ṣṣbeḥ, ad tesscemḍed min iceṭṭen di tmessi. Ittxeṣṣa war t ittett ḥed, minzi d ict n řḥajjet iqeddsen i yeǧa.
Ammu i ɣa tegged ak-d Harun u ak-d warraw nnes, ad tegged ɛlaḥsab marra min d ac weṣṣiɣ. Ad ten tařeqqmed sebɛa n wussan.
Kuř ass ad tesswejded afunas ameẓyan d taɣarṣt n ddenb i weṣřaḥ uca ad tekksed ddenb x uɛalṭar umi xas ɣa tessiwḍed aṣřaḥ, uca xenni ad t tdehned, maḥend ad t tessqeddsed.
Sebɛa n wussan ad tegged aṣřaḥ x uɛalṭar uca ad t tessqeddsed, xenni ad yiři d amqeddas qaɛ. Wenni i ɣa iḥadan aɛalṭar, ad yiři d amqeddas.
D man aya i ɣa tesswejded x uɛalṭar: tnayen n izmaren n ijj n useggʷas, kuř ass řebda.
Ad tesswejded ijj n yezmar di ṣṣbeḥ u izmar nneɣni ad t tesswejded jar beddu n wezyen n wass ař dd-tewḍa tmeddit.
I yijj n yezmar ad teksid ɛecra di tesɣart n ijj n ifa n waren azdad ixeǧḍen s zzect ddzen tt-i-dd zi zzitun, u arebɛa di tesɣart n ijj n uhinu n binu d tawhibt n useyyeb.

Ad tɣarṣed i yezmar nneɣni jar beddu n wezyen n wass ař dd-tewḍa tmeddit. Ad ɣares tarnid tawhibt n řɣiǧet am mammec tenni n ṣṣbeḥ u ɛawed tawhibt nnes n useyyeb. Aqa d řefwaḥet ittfuḥen. Aqa d tawhibt n tmessi i SIDI.
Ad tiři d taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ řebda di marra jjiřat nwem ɣar wadaf n Uqiḍun n Umsagar zzat i wudem n SIDI, mani ɣa ssmuneɣ akidwem, maḥend ad kidek ssiwřeɣ din.
Ad mmsagareɣ din ak-d ayt n Israil, u Aqiḍun ad ittwaqeddes s uɛuǧi inu.
Ad ssqeddseɣ Aqiḍun n Umsagar d uɛalṭar. Ad ssqeddseɣ ɛawed Harun d warraw nnes, ḥima ad ayi iřin d ikehhanen.
Ad zedɣeɣ di řwesṭ n ayt n Israil, ad asen iřiɣ d AREBBI
uca ad ssnen belli Necc d SIDI, AREBBI nsen, wenni ten issuffɣen zi temmurt n Miṣra, maḥend ad zedɣeɣ di řwesṭ nsen. Necc d SIDI, AREBBI nsen.”

footnotes.text: tukehhant- awař-a ixs ad yini ‘řxedmet n ukehhan’. Ad tařeqqmed Harun d tarwa nnes.- s Tɛibranit ‘Ad teccured ifassen n Harun d tarwa nnes.’
ahinu- ijj n ‘uhinu’ dayes 6 ½ litru n waman niɣ n uceffay u n řeḥwayej nneɣni, u 6,5 litru ittawi-dd 1/6 ‘bath’. Ijj n ‘bath’ imun dayes xenni 6 n ‘uhinu’, ixs ad yini ɛřayen 40 litru.
